title: Coorg
subtitle: Madikeri · Abbey Falls · Talacauvery · Coffee Plantations
inclusions: Sleeper Class Train Tickets both ways (3AC upgrade available)

itinerary.title: Board Train from Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reporting Station: Panvel Station. Reporting Time: 10:30 AM. Board train for Mangaluru. Overnight journey. 24 June 2026 (Wednesday)

itinerary.title: Reach Mangaluru & Travel to Coorg
itinerary.description: Arrive at Mangaluru Junction by 06:00 AM. Travel to Madikeri by Non-AC Bus (3 hrs). En-route breakfast. Check in at hotel. Freshen up. Evening at leisure. Dinner and overnight stay. 25 June 2026 (Thursday)

itinerary.title: Coorg Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for Coorg sightseeing. Visit Dubare Elephant Camp for elephant interaction. Visit Golden Temple (Namdroling Monastery) in Bylakuppe. Explore local spice plantations. Dinner and overnight stay. 26 June 2026 (Friday)

itinerary.title: Abbey Falls & Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from hotel. Visit Abbey Falls, the stunning cascade in the coffee plantations. Later, proceed to Mangaluru Junction Station. Board train for Mumbai. 27 June 2026 (Saturday)

itinerary.title: Reach Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reach Mumbai by approximately 10:45 AM on 28 June 2026. Return home with sweet memories!
